QUOTE: Mirrors the engine's interrupt flag into the C-ABI cancel int for one batch call
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the observer thread mirrors the atomic interrupt flag into a plain C-ABI cancel int. It also notes the poller uses `std::atomic<bool>` while the backend reads a plain `int*`. Together these give the bridging purpose. It never says outright that the C ABI cannot carry an atomic, but the mechanism is stated.
